title: Show critical notifications on all screens
line: Critical notifications, like a low battery warning, now pop up on every screen instead of only the one with the notification icon.
explanation: Notification popups are placed only on the screen that holds the notification applet (usually the laptop's panel). With a projector or a second monitor, a critical popup such as "Battery Low" stayed on the screen nobody was looking at. Now every critical popup also gets a copy on each other screen, stacked in the same corner and following screen changes. The copies show the same content and forward every button (close, actions, reply, configure) to the original popup, so acting on either one handles the notification everywhere.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: show critical notifications on all screens

Popups only appeared on the screen of the notification applet, so with
a projector or a second monitor a low battery warning was easy to miss.
Critical notifications now also get a copy on every other screen.

BUG: 471114

media.caption: Master, two screens: the critical "Battery Low" popup only appears on the left screen; the right screen shows nothing.
With the fix: the critical popup also appears on the right screen; the normal notification stays only on the main screen.
The copy on the right screen has the same action buttons; clicking "Remind Me Later" there invoked the action and closed the notification on both screens.
After disabling and re-enabling the second screen the copies follow: here the panel moved to the right screen, so the copy is now on the left.
